collection.title: Tech Resume Rubrics & Exemplars
collection.description: Forensic analysis of software engineering resumes with line-by-line rewrites and scoring rubrics.
collection.scopeLabel: 2 Forensic Resume Audits & Rewrites for College Tech Placements

items.subject: Career & Placement
items.body: **Resume Finding: Lack of Metric Quantification**: Bullet points under "Experience" describe duties rather than measurable business/technical outcomes.

metadata.location: Experience section: "Worked on frontend features using React"
metadata.rewriteOriginal: Worked on frontend features using React
metadata.rewriteImproved: Architected and shipped 6 responsive React modules, reducing page load latency by 32% for 45k monthly active users
metadata.rationale: Replaces passive verb "worked" with active leadership verb and quantifies impact.

items.subject: Career & Placement
items.body: **Resume Finding: Cluttered Skills Matrix**: Skills listed as an unorganized 20-word comma-separated string without categorization.

metadata.location: Skills section: "Java, C++, Python, SQL, Git, Linux, Docker, React, HTML, CSS, Figma, Agile"
metadata.rewriteOriginal: Java, C++, Python, SQL, Git, Linux, Docker, React, HTML, CSS, Figma, Agile
metadata.rewriteImproved: Languages: Java, C++, Python | Frameworks: React, Node.js | Infrastructure: Docker, Linux, Git
metadata.rationale: Categorized skills allow ATS parsers and hiring managers to scan proficiencies in under 3 seconds.
